sql: SELECT o.ticket_id, o.opened_at, o.product_sku, o.status, o.restored_at, (SELECT group_concat(credit_id||':'||amount_usd||':'||approved_on) FROM service_credits c WHERE c.ticket_id=o.ticket_id) credits FROM service_tickets o WHERE o.account_id='CRM-2048' ORDER BY julianday(o.opened_at)
